---

**Problem / opportunity**
What would this improve? (e.g. "Players can't easily compare two evidence items side by side.")

**Proposed solution**
A clear description of what you want to happen.

**Alternatives considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, mockups, or references to related cases/features. If you're willing to implement it yourself, say so — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mihsanalam/Her-Story/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
